summary: Rules apply to current values. Frozen originals and manual locks stay protected.
limit: Maximum changes per person, task and field
limitHint: Blank means unlimited. Zero blocks ordinary changes. The first entry counts; limits do not reset by week.
ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change these rules.
invalid: Enter a valid local date and time, and a whole change limit from 0 to 1,000,000.
deadlineBlocked: The field deadline has passed. Your unsent value is kept.
quotaBlocked: You have used {{used}} of {{limit}} changes for this task field. Your unsent value is kept.
unavailable: Could not load field rules. The server still checks every change.
reasonRequired: Enter a reason of 1–500 characters before applying the exception.
exceptionHint: Applies once to the current value and records your reason. Manual locks and frozen originals remain protected.
changedWhileEditing: Rules changed while you were editing. Your draft and its original revision are kept.
